Fixed. Changed `now > expiresAt` to `now >= expiresAt` in `/tmp/wk-rootcause-bkOEkl/repo/src/auth/session.js:3`.

**Root cause:** Boundary condition bug. Strict comparison (`>`) allowed the session to be valid at the exact expiration millisecond. Per the comment, session becomes invalid *at* the expiry instant, not after. `>=` catches that boundary.
